title: Furniture & decoration photography for e-commerce
metaTitle: Furniture photography: how to automate your visual production for the web
description: Discover how to automate the photography of furniture and decorative objects with Orbitvu photo studios. Cost reduction, visual consistency, time savings: boost your e-commerce.
author: PackshotCreator
content:
La photography of furniture and decorative objects has very specific constraints. Whether they are sofas, sideboards, or finer pieces of furniture, the products are bulky, heavy, and often difficult to handle or light properly.
However, with the rise of e-commerce, offer visuals impacting, consistent and Contoured has become unavoidable. It is in this context that solutions such as those proposed by Orbitvu via PackshotCreator make it possible to profoundly transform the way this content is produced.

An ultra-dynamic market that imposes new visual standards

The furniture and decoration sector is among the most active in online commerce. With thousands of references to shoot every year, brands and retailers must meet several requirements:

  • Accelerate their time-to-market
  • maintaining a constant quality of visuals
  • control their content production costs
  • meet the visual standards of marketplaces and enriched product sheets

Furniture Studio: the Orbitvu solution dedicated to furniture photography

Designed specifically for the needs of the sector, the Furniture Studio is an automated photo studio that allows you to photograph, crop, animate, and publish visual content for products ranging from up to 4 tons.
This solution integrates:

‍

‍

  • a motorized turntable with a diameter of 3 to 5 meters
  • a motorized camera support to control height, tilt, and zoom
  • a complete lighting system fully controllable by software
  • intelligent automation and post-production software with AI (Orbitvu Station)

The set allows Take a complete, multi-angle or 360° view of a piece of furniture in less than 3 minutes, with settings that can be reproduced identically across entire ranges of products.

Ashley Gemao, photographer at Dovetail Furniture, testifies

In a video posted by Orbitvu, Ashley shares her feedback after several months of using the Furniture Studio:

‍

‍

‍

“The biggest challenge was to keep the images consistent: the light, the angles, the colors. In a traditional studio, it's difficult because you have to do everything by hand.”

“Personally, my favorite function is the turntable. I don't need to lift or move heavy furniture myself. All I have to do is ask my team to position the object in the center, and I control everything from the computer.”

“The consistency of light and angles is impressive. It saves a lot of time: just one photo is enough.”

“The AI clipping tool works great, even on products that are difficult to isolate, such as black and white ones. In 95% of the cases, I don't even touch the image.”

“Today, we're producing faster, with higher quality, and we've even started shooting lifestyle shots. Orbitvu has really opened up new possibilities.”

Advanced features built into the Furniture Studio

Reproducible parameterization

All light settings, framing, clipping, editing can be stored in predefined templates to be reused by product or by range.

Motorized camera movement

The motorized support automatically controls the height, tilt, and zoom of the device. The result is regular and accurate, even with products with complex shapes.

Optimized and remotely controllable lighting

The LED lighting, integrated into the architecture of the studio, is controlled from Orbitvu Station. It allows you to obtain a pure white background without retouching, homogeneous lighting, and to adjust the lights according to the materials or finishes of the furniture.

AI background removal

Automatic trimming, including on difficult materials, is performed in real time thanks to aScalable AI. This reduces the post-production load considerably.

Direct export to e-commerce

Images and videos can be sent directly to a CMS, a marketplace platform, or an internal image bank, without additional manipulation.

‍

‍

‍

Why automate the production of visuals in the furniture & decoration sector?

  • Time saver : automated studios reduce shooting and processing time from several hours to a few minutes.
  • Visual homogeneity : perfect consistency of visuals across an entire catalog, even with several operators.
  • Cost reduction : less outsourcing, less retouching, fewer errors.
  • Accelerated online launch : the content can be immediately used on the site or networks.

Conclusion

Automating the photography of your furniture and decorative objects means choosing a professional, repeatable and scalable approach. Thanks to Orbitvu technologies distributed by PackshotCreator, you can produce Internally visual content from consistent quality, while gaining in agility And in cost reduction.

faqs.question: Why automate furniture photography for e-commerce?
faqs.answer: Automation makes it possible to quickly produce high-quality visuals, ensuring visual consistency across your entire catalog. This reduces time to market, improves operational efficiency, and provides greater flexibility to respond to market changes.

faqs.question: What types of content can I create with an automated furniture photo studio?
faqs.answer: With solutions like Orbitvu's Furniture Studio, you can create still photos, 360 animations, and videos of your furniture, whether small or large. The built-in software handles various file formats (JPEG, PNG, MP4, etc.) and automates the process from capture to publication.

faqs.question: Do I need to be an experienced photographer to use these solutions?
faqs.answer: No, a basic knowledge of photography is useful, but not essential. Automated studios are designed to be user-friendly, with clear manuals and dedicated training to help you get started easily. Experienced photographers will also appreciate the advanced features offered to carry out creative projects.

faqs.question: What lens is recommended for furniture photography?
faqs.answer: To avoid distortions, it is advisable to use a versatile lens between 50 and 75mm, rather than macro or wide-angle lenses. This ensures images that are proportionate and true to reality.

faqs.question: How do I ensure visual coherence between the different photos in my catalog?
faqs.answer: Automated studios allow predefined templates to be saved including lighting, camera, and post-production settings. By reusing these models, you ensure consistency across all of your visuals, thus strengthening the identity of your brand.
